what: The product panel (left text, right photo cell) is pinned to the screen, and among the sections stacked on the photo cell, from the second one each rises from 100% below to cover the previous one — 1000px of scroll per section, scrub 2 (follows 2 seconds late), power1.inOut per section. The pin releases when the last one fully covers.

options.[data-fx-part=pin]: Plate to pin to (optional) — if none, the part element itself
options.[data-fx-part=slides]: Slot that stacks sections (height is fixed)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: Sections that slide up over the page — stacked on top in document order
options.min: Pin only at this width (px) or wider, default 0 (always) — Brand 769

use:
Text
Photo 1

Photo 3
note: With reduced motion, sections are stacked vertically instead of pinned
